blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules. We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), which separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering. An executable engine maintains state and resolves interactions. A deterministic compiler encodes these outcomes and attempted actions in a spatially and temporally aligned interaction proxy. The proxy aligns action and skill windows, brief hit reactions, and persistent health by fighter identity and timing. These cues can be controlled separately to render interactions under modified rules. Identity-bound references preserve character appearance across side switches. We train FWM on FightWorld Corpus, spanning 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond the native game. It also allows character and arena customization. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of FWM, which outperforms existing game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, health-state consistency, and character appearance preservation. Our project is available at https://fight-world-model.github.io.
blocks.zh: 一个可播放,可编程的游戏世界必须保持持续状态,执行可执行规则,并支持可扩展的游戏玩法力学. 现有的影视世界模型可以产生可信的战斗,但为了保持打击反应和健康更新符合游戏规则而奋斗. 我们引入了"战斗世界模型"(Fight World Model (FWM)),它将统治的战斗处决与视频渲染区分开来. 可执行引擎保持状态并解决相互作用. 一个决定性的编译器将这些结果编码,并试图在一个空间和时间对齐的交互代理中进行动作. 代理机将动作和技巧窗口,短暂的命中反应,以及由战斗机身份和时间造成的持续健康. 这些提示可被单独控制,以根据被修改的规则进行交互. 带有身份的参考文献保存了侧开关之间的字符外观。 我们在FightWorld Corpus上训练FWM, 包括52个技能效果,187个人物出场变体和15个竞技场. FWM在不再培训出产者的情况下,支持损害缩放,受限的免疫,活体,以及超越本土游戏的多阶段技能机制. 它还允许人物和竞技场定制. 实验演示了FWM的功效,在动作忠贞性,命中反应,健康状态一致性,以及人物外观保存方面,它比现有的游戏世界模型表现得更好. 我们的项目可查阅https://fight-world-model.github.io。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive world models aim to simulate how environments evolve under user actions [ 10 , 2 , 27 , 47 , 46 ] . Recent video world models learn from gameplay recordings to generate playable sequences from controller or text inputs [ 33 , 7 , 43 , 39 , 30 , 15 ] . Customizing such worlds requires changing both gameplay rules and visual appearances. In multi-fighter combat, the same attack may cause different health loss under different rules. A protected fighter may react to a hit without losing health, while lifesteal may restore the attacker’s health. When only character or arena appearance changes, the specified interactions should remain the same. As illustrated in Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies , a customizable system must allow interaction outcomes to follow edited rules while preserving those interactions across appearance changes.
blocks.zh: 互动世界模型旨在模拟环境在用户行动下的演变情况[10、2、27、47、46]。 近期的视频世界模型从游戏机录音中学习,从控制器或文本输入中生成可播放序列[33,7,43,39,30,15]. 定制这样的世界需要改变游戏游戏规则和视觉外观. 在多战斗机的战斗中,同样的攻击在不同的规则下可能造成不同的健康损失. 被保护的战斗机可能会在不丧失健康的情况下对击球机作出反应,而救生机可能会恢复攻击者的健康. 当只有字符或竞技场外观发生变化时,指定的相互作用应该保持不变. 如《世界战斗模式》所示: 通过视觉交互代理进行自定义战斗,一个自定义系统必须允许交互结果遵循编辑后的规则,同时保留外观变化之间的这些相互作用。

blocks.en: These requirements are difficult to meet when state transitions are inferred within the video generator [ 33 , 7 , 39 , 15 , 5 , 37 ] . The model learns how actions relate to reactions and state changes from recorded gameplay. StatePlay further predicts game-state variables, such as health, alongside video frames [ 21 ] , but predicting state does not itself provide an editable rule for updating it. Multi-entity action binding, identity-aware instructions, and NPC planning extend control over characters [ 51 , 28 , 8 , 37 , 36 ] . They do not by themselves determine how interaction outcomes should change under a new rule configuration. When rules change, a generator may retain familiar action–consequence associations from training and deviate from the externally specified outcomes.
blocks.zh: 在视频生成器内推断状态过渡时,这些要求难以满足[33、7、39、15、5、37]。 该模型从录制的游戏游戏中学习动作与反应和状态变化的关系. 状态 进一步播放预测游戏状态变量,如健康,与视频帧[21],但预测状态本身并不为更新提供可编辑规则. 多实体动作约束,身份意识指示,国家计委规划扩大对字符的控制[51,28,8,37,36]. 它们本身并不确定在新的规则配置下互动结果应如何改变。 当规则改变时,生成者可能保留熟悉的行动-后果协会从培训中退出,并偏离外部规定的结果。

blocks.en: Code-driven world models offer a way to execute world-state transitions outside the video generator and render the resulting spatial proxies [ 6 , 16 , 44 , 42 ] . Correct state execution alone, however, does not ensure that the generated interaction follows those results. The renderer must identify the acting and affected fighters, depict each event at the intended time, and preserve the resulting state across subsequent exchanges. Spatial layouts alone do not specify action windows, hit reactions, or persistent health changes. Text and state tokens can carry these quantities, but the renderer must map them to the appropriate body regions, heads-up display (HUD) elements, and video frames. Appearance customization adds a related difficulty: actions and consequences must remain associated with the intended fighters as their appearances change or they exchange positions. The interface must therefore convey attempted actions, events, and persistent state with consistent identity and timing.
blocks.zh: 代码驱动的世界模型为在视频生成器外执行世界状态过渡提供了一种方法,并使由此产生的空间代号[6,16,44,42]. 然而,仅仅正确的国家执行并不能确保所产生的互动遵循这些结果。 制作者必须识别演技和受影响的战斗人员,在预定时间描绘每个事件,并在随后的交流中保持结果状态。 仅空间布局并不能指定动作窗口、撞击反应或持续的健康变化。 文本和状态符号可以携带这些数量,但渲染器必须将其映射到适当的体区,头部显示(HUD)元素,以及视频帧. 外观定制增加了一个相关的困难:行动和后果必须随着作战对象的外观变化或交换立场而与其相关。 因此,界面必须传递企图采取的行动、发生的事件和持续状态,并保持一贯的特性和时间。

blocks.en: We introduce Fight World Model (FWM), a customizable world-model framework that connects executable combat rules to video generation through a visual interaction proxy. As shown in Fig. 2 , an executable engine resolves interactions and maintains state. A deterministic compiler rasterizes fighter states, action and skill windows, and transient hit-reaction cues onto a shared canvas and timeline. Reactions and health updates are encoded separately, allowing a hit to trigger a visible response without necessarily reducing health. Rule edits change the executed records and the resulting proxy, while the proxy format and renderer remain unchanged. Character and arena references specify appearance, with identity binding associating character references with the intended fighters across side switches. This design lets the same trained renderer depict interactions under different rules and visual appearances.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Fight World Model(FWM),这是一个自定义的世界模式框架,通过视觉交互代理将可执行的战斗规则与视频生成连接起来. 如图2所示,可执行引擎解决相互作用并保持状态。 一个决定性的编译器将战斗机状态,动作和技巧窗口,以及瞬时的命中反应提示点,放在共享的画布和时间线上. 反应与健康更新被单独编码,允许命中引发可见的反应而不一定降低健康. 规则编辑更改已执行的记录和产生的代理,而代理格式和渲染器保持不变. 字符和竞技场的引用指定了外观,而身份约束则将字符引用与预定的战斗机连接到侧开关之间。 这种设计让同样的训练有素的渲染器在不同的规则和视觉外观下描绘相互作用.

blocks.en:
We instantiate and evaluate FWM in a fixed-view two-fighter combat setting. FightWorld Corpus pairs gameplay videos with interaction proxies across 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas. FWM outperforms adapted game world models in action fidelity, hit reactions, persistent health accuracy, and character appearance preservation. Under matched executed records, reference binding, and training budgets, the interaction proxy also achieves higher joint fidelity than spatial proxies augmented with text or state tokens. Without retraining the renderer, FWM supports damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, lifesteal, and multi-stage skill mechanisms beyond native Street Fighter II/III. Appearance and side-switch evaluations test whether specified interactions and reference-to-entity associations are preserved under visual changes.
We make the following contributions: • We present FWM, a customizable combat world-model system that supports editable interaction rules and character or arena appearances without retraining the renderer. • We design a visual interaction proxy that separately encodes action windows, hit reactions, and persistent health with consistent identity and timing. Identity binding connects appearance references to the fighters participating in these interactions. • We construct FightWorld Corpus and evaluate the system through comparisons with existing methods, controlled encoding studies, rule interventions, and appearance customization.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Game World Models. Action-conditioned video world models predict future frames from user inputs [ 2 , 33 , 1 ] . Recent systems extend this approach toward real-time streaming, longer horizons, and broader environments [ 7 , 43 , 48 , 11 , 39 , 30 , 9 , 5 ] . Beyond navigation and player-centric interaction, multi-entity control introduces the need to associate each input with the intended character. Per-player keyboard streams can be paired with character references [ 15 ] , while language conditions, persistent subject tokens, and synchronized inputs support multiple subjects or players [ 51 , 28 , 31 ] . Compact state representations also support NPC planning [ 8 ] . ReactiveGWM v1 separates player keyboard control from NPC strategy conditioning [ 37 ] , and ReactiveGWM v2 uses identity handles to direct action and rule text to either fighter [ 36 ] . StatePlay additionally predicts health and skill meters alongside video through a dedicated state branch [ 21 ] . These methods improve action specification, entity control, and state prediction, but interaction outcomes remain largely governed by learned video dynamics. We focus on rendered reactions and persistent state under externally edited rules.
blocks.zh: 游戏世界模型. 有条件的视频世界模型通过用户输入预测未来帧[2,33,1]. 最近的系统将这种方法推广到实时流线、更长的视野和更广泛的环境[7、43、48、11、39、30、9、5]。 除了导航和玩家中心互动之外,多实体控制引入了将每个输入与预期字符关联起来的需要. 玩家键盘流可以与字符引用[15]对齐,而语言条件,持续的主题符号,以及同步输入支持多个主题或玩家[51,28,31]. 契约州代表也支持国家计委规划[8]. 反应GWM v1将玩家键盘控制从NPC策略条件[37]中分离出来,ReactiveGWM v2使用身份手柄来引导动作和规则文本给任何一个战斗机[36]. 状态 透过专门的州立分行, 这些方法改进了动作规格,实体控制,以及状态预测,但互动结果在很大程度上仍受学习到的视频动态的制约. 我们侧重于根据外部编辑的规则做出的反应和持续状态。

blocks.en: World State and Visual Proxies. Spatial and trajectory conditioning provides explicit control over object placement and motion in video generation [ 45 , 35 , 25 , 38 ] . Recent world models separate state execution or maintenance from video rendering [ 6 , 16 , 44 , 42 , 3 ] . MASS maintains a learned authoritative state shared across players [ 3 ] , while Magpie translates white-box engine frames into generated video [ 44 ] . Oneira represents geometry and coarse interaction states through colored 3D boxes [ 42 ] . Code World Model compiles depth, semantic-ID, and instance maps from executable code [ 6 ] , and Programmable World Model projects 3D boxes into identity, semantic-category, and motion-direction maps [ 16 ] . These methods establish explicit interfaces between world state and visual generation. Our focus is on the interaction information needed when edited rules change the relationship between attempted actions, hit reactions, and persistent health.
blocks.zh: 世界状态与视觉近缘. 空间和轨迹调节对物体在视频生成中的放置和运动提供了明确的控制[45、35、25、38]。 近代世界模型将状态执行或维护与视频渲染[6,16,44,42,3]分开. MASS维持一个在玩家之间共享的博学权威状态[3],而Magpie将白盒引擎帧翻译为生成视频[44]. Oneira通过彩色3D盒代表几何和粗细的相互作用状态[42]. 代码世界模型将深度,语义-ID,以及实例地图从可执行代码[6],可编程世界模型项目3D盒编成身份,语义类,运动方向地图[16]. 这些方法建立了世界状态和视觉生成之间的明确界面. 我们的焦点是编辑规则改变企图行动、打击反应和持续健康之间的关系时所需的互动信息。

blocks.en: Reference-Guided Video Generation. Reference-guided video generators condition diffusion models on reference images to preserve subject appearance across frames [ 23 , 17 , 49 , 40 , 13 ] . Multi-subject methods use spatial masks, semantic alignment from vision-language models, or binding slots to distinguish appearances across entities [ 20 , 50 , 41 ] . Character animation and motion-transfer methods drive reference subjects through explicit pose sequences [ 14 ] or in-context spatiotemporal tokens aligned with the output video [ 26 , 41 ] . In our setting, appearance references must remain associated with the fighters performing each action and receiving each consequence, including through side switches. We study this association jointly with rule-controlled interaction outcomes.
blocks.zh: 参考-指导视频世代. 参考制导的视频生成器在参考图像上的条件传播模型,以保持标的跨帧外观[23,17,49,40,13]. 多主体方法使用空间口罩,语义与视觉语言模型的对齐,或者绑定槽来区分跨实体的外观[20,50,41]. 字符动画和运动传动方法通过显式的姿势序列[14]或与输出视频一致的内文spatiotemporal符号驱动参考对象[26,41]. 在我们的环境下,外观参考必须与执行每项行动和接受每项结果的战斗人员相联系,包括通过侧开关。 我们研究这种联系和规则控制的互动结果。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: FWM supports rule and appearance customization by coupling executable state updates with conditional video generation. As shown in Fig. 2 , an engine executes the active rules, and a deterministic compiler converts the resulting states and events into a visual interaction proxy. Rule edits change the executed interaction and proxy, while appearance edits retain the proxy and change the references. Both use the same trained renderer.
blocks.zh: FWM支持规则和外观定制,将可执行状态更新与有条件的视频生成结合. 如图2所示,一个引擎执行活动规则,一个决定性的编译器将由此产生的状态和事件转换成视觉交互代理. 规则编辑更改已执行的交互和代理,而外观编辑则保留代理并更改引用. 两者都使用相同的训练有素的渲染器.

blocks.en: An appearance edit changes the character or arena references while keeping the executed records and proxy fixed. Character references retain their target entity identities. Rule and appearance edits can also be combined by rendering recomputed records with new appearance conditions. For successive action intervals, the engine carries its state forward, while visual context supports continuity between generated segments.
blocks.zh: 外观编辑会改变字符或竞技场引用,同时保留已执行的记录和代理的固定. 字符引用保留其目标实体身份. 规则和外观编辑也可以通过将重制的记录与新的外观条件结合起来. 对于连续的动作间隔,引擎会将状态向前承载,而视觉上下文则支持生成段之间的连续性.

blocks.en: 3.2 Interaction Proxy
blocks.zh: 3.2 互动代理

blocks.en: The proxy separates attempted actions, transient reactions, and persistent state because editable rules can change their relationship. These signals share entity identities and frame indices, allowing their values and durations to vary without changing the conditioning format. We describe the concrete combat encoding used in our experiments below.
blocks.zh: 代理将尝试的动作,瞬间的反应,和持续的状态分开,因为可编辑的规则可以改变它们的关系. 这些信号共享实体身份和帧指数,允许它们的值和持续时间变化而不改变条件格式. 我们描述我们下面实验中使用的具体战斗编码。

blocks.en: For this instantiation, the visible state at video frame t t is s t = { ( i , b t i , f t i , q t i , a t i , h t i ) } i = 1 2 , s_{t}=\{(i,b_{t}^{i},f_{t}^{i},q_{t}^{i},a_{t}^{i},h_{t}^{i})\}_{i=1}^{2}, (2) where i i is a persistent fighter identity, and b b , f f , q q , a a , and h h denote its bounding box, facing direction, stance, coarse action label, and health. Each fighter’s box and HUD health bar share an identity color. Facing and stance marks encode orientation and posture, and a separate band encodes the coarse action label, including an unknown value for unannotated actions.
blocks.zh: 对于这个即时反应,视频帧 t t 的可见状态是 s = {(i, b t i, f t i, q i, a t i, h t i)}i = 1 2, s _{t }=\{ (i, b_{t}^{i), f_{t}^{i}, q_{t}^{i}, a_{t}^{i}, h_{t}^{i)} \}_{i = 1}^{2}, (2) i 是一个持久的战斗机身份,b b, f f, q q, a, h 表示它的边框,面对方向,姿态,粗糙的动作标签,以及健康. 每个战斗机盒和HUD健康栏都有一个身份颜色。 面对和姿势标记编码方向和姿势,一个单独的波段编码粗糙的动作标签,包括一个未知的无注释动作值.

blocks.en: Action and Skill Windows. For the fighter with logged inputs, six attack classes combine punches and kicks with light, medium, and heavy strengths. Horizontal stripes encode punches and vertical stripes encode kicks, with coverage indicating strength. The marks remain active during the command window and supplement the coarse labels available for both fighters. They encode attempted actions, with hit outcomes specified separately. At inference, the engine can assign command windows to either fighter through its persistent identity.
blocks.zh: 动作与技能视窗. 对于有登录输入的战斗机,6个攻击课结合了拳击和踢踢与轻,中,重强. 水平条纹编码拳击和垂直条纹编码踢踢,覆盖显示强度. 标记在命令窗口期间仍然活跃,并补充了两个战斗机可用的粗细标签. 它们编码了未遂行动,并分别具体说明命中结果。 推论,该引擎可以通过其持续的身份为任一战斗机分配命令窗口.

blocks.en: A magenta block in front of the caster follows its position and facing direction to mark a skill’s casting window. Text describes the effect’s type and appearance, so the corpus’s 52 visual skill effects share the same casting marker.
blocks.zh: 铸币师面前的红酒块沿着其位置并面向方向,以标记技能的铸币窗口. 文字描述效果的种类和外观,因此该物剂的52种视觉技巧效果共用同一个铸造标记.

blocks.en: Reactions and Persistent State. Reaction onset is marked by briefly inverting the affected fighter’s box fill and health-bar color. Bar length independently encodes health. This supports a protected hit with a reaction cue but no health decrease, or lifesteal with an additional update to the attacker’s health. Identity colors associate each reaction and state update with the affected fighter across side switches.
blocks.zh: 反应和持久状态。 反应爆发的标志是短暂地倒置受影响的战斗机的盒子填充和保健栏颜色。 栏长度独立编码健康. 这支持有反应提示的受保护打击,但不会降低健康,也不会增加攻击者健康的最新情况。 身份颜色将每个反应联系起来,并状态更新与受影响的战斗机交叉侧开关.

blocks.en: The same compiler processes video-derived annotations during training and engine-generated records at inference. Training reaction onsets are inferred from observed health decreases, while the engine specifies reaction events and health under the edited rules. The shared format therefore permits rule-dependent cue combinations beyond those implied by the training annotations. Rule-intervention experiments test whether the trained renderer realizes these combinations. Broad command stripes and four-frame inversions are designed to retain cues through spatial and temporal compression by the video variational autoencoder (VAE) [ 18 , 19 ] . Detailed motion, textures, and effect appearance are supplied by the renderer.
blocks.zh: 同一编译器在培训期间处理视频生成的说明,并在推断时处理引擎生成的记录。 训练反应的发生是从观察到的健康下降推断出来的,而发动机则根据编辑的规则规定了反应事件和健康。 因此,共享格式允许在培训说明所隐含的内容之外,以规则为基础的提示组合。 规则干涉实验测试训练有素的渲染器是否意识到这些组合. 宽度指令条纹和四帧反转设计是为了通过视频变异自编码器(VAE)的时空压缩来保留提示[18,19]. 详细的运动,纹理,以及效果外观由渲染器提供.

blocks.en: 3.3 Video Rendering and Identity Binding
blocks.zh: 3.3 录像制作和身份约束

blocks.en: We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on the proxy and appearance inputs. Video, reference, and proxy inputs share a VAE and patch embedding. Their tokens are concatenated in video–reference–proxy order, with learned channel-wise gates on the reference and proxy streams. The initial video context, proxy, and references remain clean, while future video latents are denoised. Text descriptions are encoded by the text encoder and supplied through cross-attention. Only video tokens are decoded.
blocks.zh: 我们在代理和外观输入上 设定一个预先训练好的视频传播变压器 视频、参考资料和代理输入共享一个 VAE 和补丁嵌入。 他们的标语以视频 - 参考 - 代用顺序来缩写,在参考和代理流上都有学习到的频道门. 最初的视频背景,代理,和参考信息仍然干净,而未来的视频潜伏则被取消. 文本描述由文本编码器编码,通过交叉注意提供. 只有视频符号被解码.

The text condition c c describes appearance and skill-effect type. The proxy supplies executed interaction states and event schedules.

blocks.en: Proxy tokens share spatiotemporal rotary positions with the corresponding video tokens [ 32 ] . Reference tokens use positions outside the video grid, distinguishing appearance conditions from video-aligned interaction cues.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , shared identity embeddings bind character references to persistent entity identities. For each training sample, we assign the fighters distinct slots sampled without replacement from a learned codebook. Each fighter’s slot embedding is added to its corresponding tokens in the first video latent and throughout the proxy sequence, weighted by soft bounding-box coverage. The same embedding is added to all tokens of that fighter’s reference. Random slot assignment discourages a fixed mapping between codebook entries and appearances. At inference, the target identity attached to a character reference selects its slot embedding. Arena references do not use an entity slot.
A training sample for character appearance editing contains a source initial image, a reference crop, and an edited target video. The source image establishes the scene and entity locations, while the reference specifies the target appearance in the continuation.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,共享身份嵌入对持久实体身份的字符参考。 对于每一个训练样本,我们分配了不同的战斗机插槽,没有从学到的密码簿中替换。 每架战斗机的插槽在第一个视频潜伏和整个代理序列中加入相应的标志,并用软边框覆盖加权。 同样的嵌入物也被加入到该战斗机的所有参考物中。 随机插槽任务不利于代码簿条目和外观之间的固定映射. 推论中,字符引用所附的目标身份会选择其插槽. 竞技场引用不使用实体槽.
角色外观编辑培训样本包含源头图像,参考作物,以及编辑的目标视频. 源图像确定场景和实体位置,而引用则指定续作中的目标外观.

blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: We optimize the diffusion transformer, conditioning gates, and identity codebook with flow matching [ 22 , 24 ] . The objective in Eq. 5 supervises only future video latents, while the VAE and text encoder remain frozen. We apply condition dropout [ 12 ] to proxy, reference, and text inputs. For reference-conditioned samples, appearance-description dropout encourages reliance on the reference image.
blocks.zh: 我们优化了传播变压器, 调节闸门, 和身份密码簿 与流量匹配 [22, 24]. Eq. 5中的目标只监督未来的视频潜伏,而VAE和文本编码器仍然被冻结. 我们对代理、参考和文本输入应用条件退赛[12]。 对于有参考条件的样本,外观描述中断会鼓励依赖参考图像。

blocks.en: 3.5 FightWorld Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.5 战斗世界公司

blocks.en: We construct FightWorld Corpus by pairing Street Fighter II [ 4 ] gameplay videos with interaction proxies and optional appearance references. A frozen video editor augments native recordings with edits to skill effects, character appearances, and arenas, yielding 112,618 training samples. As summarized in Fig. 3 , the corpus spans 52 skill effects, 187 character-appearance variants, and 15 arenas.

Each accepted video is paired with a character crop or an arena reference, as illustrated for scene edits in Fig. 4 .

blocks.zh: Skill编辑会改变与铸造事件相关的视觉效果,也可能改变可见的相互作用. 因此,我们从本地和技能编辑的视频中摘录状态和事件说明,仅保留通过质量放映的片段。

blocks.en: Native and edited videos share the same training format, with interaction proxies, text descriptions, and optional character or arena references as conditions. We use these samples to train a shared renderer across skill effects and appearances.
blocks.zh: 原生和编辑的视频共享相同的培训格式,以互动代理,文本描述,以及可选字符或竞技场引用作为条件. 我们用这些样本来训练一个共享的渲染器 跨越技能效应和外观。

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: Implementation. We evaluate FWM on two-fighter interactions in the fixed 2D view of Street Fighter II [ 4 ] . Our renderer uses Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 34 ] as its backbone and is trained on FightWorld Corpus.
blocks.zh: 执行。 我们评价FWM在街机二号的固定2D视野中, 我们的渲染器使用Wan2.2-TI2V-5B[34]作为其骨干,并接受过FightWorld Corpus的培训.

blocks.en: Evaluation Protocol. For recorded interactions, held-out video annotations specify the target interactions. For rule interventions, we fix the initial state and submitted actions, then rerun the engine under each rule configuration to compute trajectories, hit events, and state updates. FWM’s reference images and text condition c c remain unchanged for damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, and lifesteal. Appearance evaluations change the references while retaining the executed interaction. Each controlled encoding comparison supplies identical interaction records to all variants.
blocks.zh: 评价协议。 对于录制的交互,停放的视频说明指定了目标交互. 对于规则干预,我们固定初始状态并提交动作,然后在每个规则配置下重运行引擎来计算轨迹,命中事件,以及状态更新. FWM的参考图像和文本条件c c 保持不变,用于损害的缩放、受伤害的有限豁免和生命器械。 外观评价在保留已执行互动的同时改变引用. 每个受控编码比较向所有变体提供相同的交互记录.

blocks.en: Action and Reaction Metrics. Move Accuracy (MoveAcc) measures agreement between fighter motion and directional commands. Attack Accuracy (AttackAcc) is the fraction of detected punch or kick events supported by the corresponding input commands within their temporal windows. Skill Accuracy (SkillAcc) requires the correct skill class and an onset within the command-relative evaluation window. Reaction measures the fraction of expected hit responses visibly performed by the designated fighter. Qwen judges these responses from body motion in nearby frames, with the HUD excluded.
blocks.zh: 行动与反应计量. 移动精确度(MoveAcc)在战斗机运动和方向指令之间测量协议. 攻击精确度(英語:AttackAcc)是被检测到的拳击或踢球事件的一小部分,由相应的输入命令支持在其时间窗口内. 技能准确性(SkillAcc)需要正确的技能课,并在命令相对的评价窗口内启动. 反应测量指定战斗机明显执行的预期命中反应的一小部分。 Quen判断这些反应来自附近框架的肢体动议,不包括HUD.

blocks.en: Health and Persistence. Health MAE measures the mean absolute error between generated and target HUD health, normalized by maximum health and reported in percentage points. The joint health check requires correct updates for both fighters and persistence of the resulting health values between events.
blocks.zh: 健康与坚忍. 健康最高健康水平衡量产生与目标HUD健康之间的平均绝对差错,按照最高健康水平实现正常化,并以百分点报告。 联合健康检查要求对参战者进行正确的更新,并要求事件之间的健康价值保持不变。

blocks.en: Joint Interaction Fidelity. Joint interaction fidelity ( J J ) treats an attempt as successful only if all applicable action, entity, timing, reaction, and health checks pass. We average attempt-level results within each episode and give episodes equal weight. For rule interventions, J rule J_{\mathrm{rule}} requires the applicable reaction and health checks to pass together.
blocks.zh: 联合互动 联合互动忠诚(J J )认为,只有当所有适用的行动、实体、时间、反应和健康检查通过时,尝试才算成功。 我们在每个剧集中平均的尝试级结果,并且给予各集同等的分量. 对于规则干预,J规则J_{\mathrm{rule}}}要求适用的反应和健康检查一起通过.

blocks.en: Appearance and Entity Assignment. Adherence uses a VLM to judge whether the requested appearance is applied to the designated character or arena. The judge receives the target reference and a source-frame identity guide. DINO measures cosine similarity between reference and generated features for characters and arenas separately. Both metrics exclude the fixed initial context.
blocks.zh: 外观和实体转让。 加入使用VLM来判断请求的外观是否适用于指定的字符或竞技场. 法官收到目标参考和来源框架身份指南。 DINO测量参考物与生成的字符和竞技场的特征之间的同位素相似性. 这两个指标都排除了固定的初始上下文。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare FWM with H3-WORLD [ 5 ] , ReactiveGWM v1 [ 37 ] , and ReactiveGWM v2 [ 36 ] . We adapt all three methods to FightWorld Corpus and its 52 skill effects. For skill control, we add a dedicated trigger to v1 and v2 and specify activation in H3-WORLD’s interval action text. The +Ref variants use our reference-conditioning branch for appearance editing.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较FWM与H3-WORLD [5],ReactiveGWM v1 [37],以及ReactiveGWM v2 [36]. 我们调整了所有三种方法,以对抗世界公司及其52个技能效应。 对于技能控制,我们在v1和v2中添加一个专用触发器,并在H3-WORLD的间隔动作文本中指定激活. +Ref变体使用我们的参考调节分支进行外观编辑.

blocks.en: 4.2 Character and Scene Customization
blocks.zh: 4.2 字符和场景自定义

blocks.en: As illustrated in Fig. 5 , FWM renders the same prescribed interaction with different character and arena references. We retain the executed records and proxy while changing appearance, testing whether the specified actions and consequences are preserved.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,FWM与不同的性格和竞技场参照进行相同的规定互动。 我们保留已执行的记录和代理,同时改变外观,测试是否保留了指定的行动和后果.

blocks.en: Identity Association across Side Switches. We further test whether character references remain associated with their intended fighters across side switches. This requires preserving identity independently of the fighters’ screen positions. The variants in Table 1 share reference inputs and training budgets, differing only in whether identity binding is enabled. Binding improves character adherence and DINO similarity, with an adherence gain of approximately 45 percentage points on side-switch clips.
blocks.zh: 身份协会跨侧开关。 我们进一步测试人物参考是否仍然与他们的预定战斗机连在一起。 这需要独立于战斗人员屏幕位置保持身份。 表1中的变体共享参考投入和培训预算,仅在是否启用身份约束方面有所不同。 捆绑可以提高性格坚持度和DINO的相似性,在侧开关片段的坚持率增加约45个百分点.

blocks.en: 4.3 Control Representation Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.3 控制代表性比较

blocks.en: From Commands to Executed Outcomes. Adding rule text to action commands improves joint fidelity, but the generated interactions remain inconsistent. Spatial Proxy Only accurately controls movement while showing low joint fidelity in Table 2 . These conditions leave the renderer to infer hit events and health updates. The results motivate supplying executed outcomes alongside attempted actions.
blocks.zh: 从命令到执行结果。 将规则文本添加到动作命令中可以提高联合忠诚度,但生成的相互作用仍然不一致. 空间代理 只准确控制运动,同时在表2中显示低关节忠诚度。 这些条件使制作者可以推断出撞击事件和健康最新情况。 其结果促使在试图采取行动的同时提供已执行的成果。

blocks.en: Holding Executed Information Fixed. To isolate the effect of encoding, we compare Spatial Proxy + Text, Spatial Proxy + State Tokens, and FWM under identical executed interaction records. The records specify fighter identities, action classes, affected fighters, event onsets and durations, and frame-wise health trajectories. All variants share geometry, initial context, reference binding, backbone initialization, and training budgets.
blocks.zh: 持有已执行的信息固定。 为了隔离编码的效果,我们比较了空间代理+文本,空间代理+状态托肯斯,以及相同执行的交互记录下的FWM. 记录具体说明了战斗机的身份、动作课、受影响的战斗机、事件的发生和持续时间,以及框架式的健康轨迹。 所有变体都具有几何、初始上下文、参考约束、主干初始化和培训预算。

blocks.en: Effect of Interaction Encoding. With identical executed information, FWM improves joint fidelity by approximately 22 percentage points over Spatial Proxy + Text, the stronger symbolic baseline in Table 2 . State Tokens have lower average health error than Text but poorer joint fidelity, showing that average health accuracy does not fully capture interaction correctness.
blocks.zh: 互动编码的效果。 有了相同的执行信息,FWM比空间代理+文本提高了约22个百分点,后者是表2中较强的象征性基线。 与Text相比,State Tokens的平均健康误差较低,但共同忠诚度较低,这表明平均健康准确性不能充分反映相互作用的正确性。

blocks.en: Text misassigns damage to the attacker or misses the recipient’s health update in Fig. 6 . State Tokens track health more closely on average but lag at impact onset and show local limb blur during contact. Both baselines supply events and health as symbolic records that must be associated with body regions, HUD bars, and video frames. FWM places these cues in the corresponding proxy regions and frames.
blocks.zh: 文字错误地给攻击者指定损害, 或错过 Fig 中的收件人健康更新 。 6. 国家Tokens更密切地跟踪平均健康状况,但在撞击发生时滞后,并在接触时显示局部肢体模糊。 基线提供事件和健康是象征性的记录,必须与身体区域、HUD栏和录像框相关联。 FWM将这些提示放在相应的代理区域和帧中.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 4.4 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en: Figure 9: Skill-Level Rule Mechanisms Beyond Native Combat. Five combat mechanisms absent from native Street Fighter II/III , spanning lingering ground damage, per-projectile hits, staggered area hits, action locks, and spatial confinement (boundary locked).
blocks.zh: 图9:超越本土战斗的技能级规则机制。 当地街机II/III没有5个战斗机制, 包括残留的地面破坏、每枚投球命中、交错区域命中、动作锁和空间限制(边界锁定)。

blocks.en: Action Control and State Consistency. ReactiveGWM v1 [ 37 ] achieves higher player movement and attack precision than H3-WORLD [ 5 ] in Table 3 . It uses keyboard inputs for the player and coarser strategy text for the NPC. ReactiveGWM v2 [ 36 ] directs action instructions to either fighter, but still infers hit outcomes and health updates within video generation. The baselines miss actions and reactions in Fig. 7 , and v2 shows spurious health recovery.
blocks.zh: 行动控制和国家一致性。 ReactiveGWM v1 [37] 实现了比表3中的H3-WORLD [5]更高的玩家运动和攻击精度. 它为玩家使用键盘输入,为NPC使用紧凑策略文本. ReactiveGWM v2 [36] 向任一战斗机指示动作指令,但仍推断在视频生成中命中结果和健康更新. 基线在图7中忽略了行动和反应,v2中显示出虚假的健康恢复.

blocks.en: Multi-Phase Skills. The baselines struggle to synchronize skill effects with their consequences. In Fig. 8 , ReactiveGWM v1 and v2 deduct health before projectile impact, while H3-WORLD shows insufficient health loss after contact. ReactiveGWM v2 also renders a malformed projectile effect.
blocks.zh: 多阶段技能。 基线难以使技能效应与其后果同步。 在图8中,ReactiveGWM v1和v2在射弹撞击前扣除健康,而H3-WORLD在接触后显示健康损失不足. 反应GWM v2 也会产生畸形的投影效果.

blocks.en: Appearance and Interaction Fidelity. Adding appearance references improves v2’s movement and skill accuracy by approximately 22 and 18 percentage points, respectively. The +Ref baselines achieve high character adherence in Table 3 , yet their hit reactions and health updates remain inconsistent. Garment blur and identity drift during rapid contact and side switches further indicate that overall adherence does not guarantee stable visual identity throughout an interaction.
blocks.zh: 外观与互动 Fidelity. 加上外观参考,V2的动作和技能精度分别提高了约22和18个百分点. +参考基准在表3中实现了高性能的坚持度,然而它们的命中反应和健康更新仍然不一致. 在快速接触和侧开关期间,服装模糊和身份漂移进一步表明,总体坚持并不能保证整个互动过程中的视觉特性稳定。

blocks.en: Executed Outcomes as Visual Conditions. FWM improves action accuracy, hit reactions, health consistency, and character adherence over the adapted baselines in Table 3 . Its Reaction score exceeds the best +Ref result by approximately 43 percentage points. The rollouts in Figs. 7 and 8 follow the prescribed action and reaction timing while preserving the resulting health across subsequent frames.
blocks.zh: 执行结果作为视觉条件. FWM改进了动作精度,打击反应,健康一致性,以及相对于表3中调整后的基线的性格坚持性. 其反应分数超过最佳+参考结果约43个百分点. 法格语的推出. 7和8遵循规定的行动和反应时间,同时将由此产生的健康保留在以后的框架之内。

blocks.en: 4.5 Rule Interventions
blocks.zh: 4.5 规则干预

blocks.en: Rule and Skill Customization. We test whether generated interactions follow edited rules and newly composed skill mechanisms without retraining the renderer. For attack-level interventions, the initial state, submitted actions, appearance references, and FWM text condition c c remain fixed. The engine recomputes motion, hit timing, and state updates, and the changed outcomes reach FWM only through the proxy. FWM maintains high joint fidelity across the revised rules in Table 5 , while symbolic encodings degrade particularly under immunity and lifesteal.
blocks.zh: 规则和技能定制。 我们测试生成的相互作用是否遵循编辑的规则和新编的技巧机制,而不对制作者进行再培训。 对于攻击层面的干预,初始状态、提交的行动、外观参考和FWM文本条件c仍然固定不变。 引擎重新计算运动,命中时间,状态更新,改变后的结果只能通过代理到达FWM. FWM在表5订正规则中保持高度共同忠诚,而象征性编码则特别在豁免和生命质中降解。

blocks.en: Damage Magnitude. Damage scaling changes the health loss associated with a valid hit. FWM tracks the resulting health changes under both reduced and amplified damage, with low health error and high joint fidelity.
blocks.zh: 损害威仪. 损害规模改变与有效打击有关的健康损失。 FWM在减少和增大损害的情况下跟踪由此造成的健康变化,健康误差小,关节忠诚度高。

blocks.en: Limited-Hit Immunity. Limited-hit immunity blocks health loss for a specified number of hits while retaining reaction events. FWM renders the corresponding body responses with unchanged health during protection, then shows the prescribed health loss once protection is exhausted.
blocks.zh: 有限豁免。 受打击的有限豁免在保留反应事件的同时,阻断了特定次数的伤害健康。 FWM在保护期间做出健康不变的相应身体反应,然后在保护用尽后显示规定的健康损失。

blocks.en: Lifesteal. Under lifesteal, a hit reduces the recipient’s health and restores the attacker’s health. FWM renders these coupled updates for the correct fighters and preserves the resulting health values after the hit.
blocks.zh: 寿te. 在命脉下,一击会降低接受者的健康,恢复攻击者的健康. FWM为正确的战士提供了这些配套的更新,并保留了在击中后产生的健康价值.

blocks.en: Multi-Stage Skill Mechanisms. We extend the rule interventions to skills that combine displacement, repeated impacts, and state constraints. In Fig. 9 , Earthshatter couples knockback with staged health loss and lingering ground damage. Other mechanisms cover per-projectile hits, staggered area impacts, action locks, and spatial confinement. FWM renders these combinations through the shared proxy without additional skill-specific conditioning channels or renderer retraining.
blocks.zh: 多层次技能机制。 我们把规则干预扩大到将流离失所、反复影响和国家制约结合起来的技能。 以法义. 9,Earthshhatter夫妇 反击 舞台上的健康损失 和持久的地面破坏。 其他机制包括每个投影击中、错开的区域撞击、动作锁和空间限制。 FWM通过共享代用来制作这些组合,没有额外的技能特异性调节通道或渲染器再培训.

blocks.en: 4.6 Proxy Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.6 代理偏差

blocks.en: Attempted Actions and Their Consequences. We retrain each variant with one cue family removed, keeping the training setting unchanged. In Table 4 , removing command marks lowers attack precision while leaving Reaction largely unchanged. Removing the skill trigger reduces skill accuracy by approximately 20 percentage points. These results support encoding attempted actions separately from their consequences.
blocks.zh: 企图采取行动及其后果。 我们重新培训每个变体,取消一个提示家庭,使培训环境保持不变。 在表4中,移除命令标记会降低攻击精度,而反应基本保持不变。 消除技能触发器将技能精度降低约20个百分点. 这些结果支持将企图采取的行动与其后果分开编码。

blocks.en: Events and Persistent State. Removing damage-event cues lowers the Reaction score while health error remains low. Removing health bars largely preserves reactions but degrades health accuracy and joint fidelity. These complementary effects support separate conditioning for transient reactions and persistent state. More details, comparisons and visualizations are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 事件与持续状态。 清除损害事件提示会降低反应分数,而健康错误仍然很低。 消除健康障碍在很大程度上保持了反应,但降低了健康准确性和共同忠诚性。 这些互补效应支持对瞬态反应和持久性状态的单独条件. 更多细节、比较和可视化载于附录。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented Fight World Model (FWM), which connects executable gameplay rules to video generation through a visual interaction proxy. Experiments in a combat setting demonstrate improved interaction and appearance fidelity over adapted game world models. FWM supports edited rules and multi-stage skill mechanisms without retraining the renderer. Character and arena customization preserves the prescribed interactions, with identity binding maintaining character associations across side switches.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了Fight World Model(FWM),通过视觉交互代理将可执行的游戏游戏规则与视频生成连接起来. 在一个战斗环境中的实验显示,互动和外表忠贞性比适应的游戏世界模型有所改进。 FWM支持编辑的规则和多阶段技能机制,而不对渲染器进行再培训. 字符和竞技场定制保留了规定的互动,身份约束维持了跨侧开关的字符关联.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Construction Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据构建细节

blocks.en: B.1 Video Editing and Quality Control
blocks.zh: B.1 视频编辑和质量控制

blocks.en: A frozen MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA editor produces appearance and skill-effect variants using edit-specific prompts. Screening checks the requested content, temporal coherence, and interaction consistency.
blocks.zh: 冷冻的迷你Max-H3 Ref2 VA编辑器使用特定编辑提示制作外观和技能效果变体. 筛选检查所要求的内容、时间一致性和互动一致性。

blocks.en: Appearance-only variants are checked against the source video for fighter trajectories, event timing, and health traces. Only edits that pass these checks reuse the source state annotations. Skill-effect edits are annotated from the edited videos.
blocks.zh: 仅用于外观的变体与战斗轨迹、事件时间和健康痕迹的源视频进行对比。 只编辑通过这些检查的重用源状态说明 。 技能效果编辑从编辑的视频中附加注释.

blocks.en: B.2 State and Event Annotation
blocks.zh: B.2 国家和事件说明

blocks.en: Gemma-4-31B-it localizes fighters at regularly spaced keyframes to initialize SAM 2 video propagation [ 29 ] . Semantic descriptions help distinguish fighters from similar background characters. At each keyframe, the tracker checks the two identity assignments against appearance and trajectory continuity, retaining or swapping them to correct drift and bridge short gaps. Bounding boxes specify spatial state. Facing direction follows relative fighter positions and retains its previous value while the boxes overlap.
blocks.zh: Gemma-4-31B-it将战斗机定位在定期间隙键框上,以初始化SAM 2视频传播[29]. 语义描述有助于区分战士和类似的背景人物. 在每个键框上,追踪器对照外观和轨迹连续性检查两个身份任务,保留或交换这些任务,以纠正漂移和弥补短距离差距。 边框指定空间状态。 面对方向遵循相对的战斗机位置,在箱子重叠时保留其先前的价值.

blocks.en: Health traces are estimated from HUD bar lengths and cleaned within each round. Nearby decreases are merged into damage events, each recording the affected fighter and event time. Gemma also supplies coarse action and stance labels at selected frames, including frames near damage events. Unannotated action frames use the unknown label. Logged inputs provide fine attack commands and scheduled skill triggers for the controlled fighter. The compiler converts these annotations into interaction proxies.
blocks.zh: 健康痕迹估计来自HUD棒长度,并在每一轮内进行清理。 附近的减少被合并为破坏事件,每次记录受影响的战斗机和事件时间. Gemma还为选定的帧提供粗糙的动作和姿势标签,包括靠近损坏事件的帧. 未附加说明的动作框使用未知的标签. 日志输入为受控战斗机提供了精细的攻击命令和预定的技能触发器. 编译器将这些注释转换为交互代理.

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Protocols
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价议定书

blocks.en: C.1 Controlled Interactions
blocks.zh: C.1 受控制的互动

blocks.en: Recorded-interaction tests use held-out video annotations, with source episodes separated between training and testing. Rule interventions rerun the engine from the same initial state and submitted actions under each configuration, recomputing motion trajectories, hit events, and state outcomes. These records define the target interactions for the compared encodings. In FWM’s damage scaling, limited-hit immunity, and lifesteal tests, reference images and text condition c c remain fixed. Changed outcomes reach FWM only through the proxy.
blocks.zh: 录音互动测试使用持有的视频说明,源片段在培训与测试之间分开. 规则干预从相同的初始状态重新运行引擎,并在每个配置下提交动作,重算运动轨迹,命中事件,以及状态结果. 这些记录定义了比较编码的目标交互. 在FWM的损伤缩放中,有限伤害的免疫力,以及生命质测试中,参考图像和文本条件cc仍然固定不变. 改变的结果只通过代理到达FWM.

blocks.en: Appearance interventions retain the executed records and proxy while changing the references. Evaluation cases include no-hit attempts, repeated attacks, overlap, and side switches.
blocks.zh: 外观干预保留已执行的记录和代理,同时更改引用. 评价案件包括无打击企图、反复攻击、重叠和侧开关。

blocks.en: Complete-Information Encodings. The encodings use matched event-free intervals, sampled values, and temporal indices, with shared resolution and sampling settings. Each uses the input layers required by its representation, and text inputs are checked for truncation.
blocks.zh: 完整信息编码. 编码使用匹配的无事件间隔、抽样值和时间指数,并有共享的分辨率和抽样设置。 每种都使用其表示需要的输入层,并检查文本输入的截图.

blocks.en: C.2 Action Recognition and Timing
blocks.zh: C.2 行动承认和时间安排

blocks.en: Movement. MoveAcc compares tracked fighter motion with directional commands over valid command windows and averages across the four movement keys. Jump positives require an actual airborne jump. Grounded hurt recovery is excluded from jump positives.
blocks.zh: 移动。 MoveAcc将履带式战斗机运动与方向性命令相比于有效的命令窗口和跨越四个移动键的平均值. 跳跃阳性需要真正的空中跳跃. 受创损伤的康复被排除在跳跃阳性之外。

blocks.en: Attack and Skill Recognition. We train ResNet-18-based temporal convolutional networks (TCNs) for attack and skill recognition. Attack detections are grouped into temporally contiguous events. AttackAcc measures the fraction of detected punch or kick events supported by the corresponding input command within its temporal window.
blocks.zh: 攻击和技能识别 我们训练基于ResNet-18的时空演化网络进行攻击和技能识别。 攻击探测分为时间毗连事件。 TattackAcc 测量在其时间窗口内由相应的输入命令支持的检测到的拳击或踢击事件的一小部分.

blocks.en: The skill classifier uses a 256-channel temporal trunk with dilation rates 1, 2, 4, and 8. It predicts onset and class, with a no-skill outcome in the onset prediction. Class logits are pooled over the predicted effect interval. SkillAcc requires the correct class and onset within the command-relative window. The same timing rule applies across methods and accommodates skill startup, release, and recovery.
blocks.zh: 技能分类器使用256通道的时空干线,其扩展速率为1,2,4和8. 它预测发病和类,在发病预测中无技能结果. 类对数在预测效果间隔上集合 。 SkillAcc要求命令-相对窗口内正确分类和触发. 同样的时间安排规则适用于各种方法,并顾及技能的启动、释放和恢复。

blocks.en: An attempted attack may hit or miss, so AttackAcc and Reaction assess command-grounded action execution and received-hit consequences, respectively.
blocks.zh: 攻击未遂可能击中或错过,因此,攻击指挥和反应分别评估有指挥根据的行动执行和受打击的后果。

blocks.en: C.3 Reaction and Health
blocks.zh: C.3 反应和健康

blocks.en: Visible Reactions. Reaction measures the fraction of expected hit responses visibly performed by the designated fighter within the evaluation window. Qwen judges body motion in surrounding gameplay frames, using a source-frame identity guide and excluding the HUD.
blocks.zh: 可见之应. 反应量出指定战斗机在评价窗口内明显执行的预期打击反应的一小部分。 Quen在围观游戏游戏帧中判断身体运动,使用源框身份指南,不包括HUD.

blocks.en: Brief reactions can resemble ordinary motion across appearances and effects, so we judge them using local temporal context around expected events. Computing reaction precision would additionally require locating every visible received-hit onset throughout the generated video, a dense detection task that is difficult for current VLMs.
blocks.zh: 短暂的反应可以像普通运动 跨外观和效果, 所以我们用局部的时间背景来判断它们 围绕预期的事件。 计算反应精度还需要在整个生成的视频中查找每一次可见的受袭发光,这一密集的检测任务对于目前的甚高频来说是困难的。

blocks.en: DINO measures reference-to-generation feature cosine similarity separately for characters and arenas. Proxy boxes localize fighter crops, while fighter and HUD regions are suppressed for arena scoring. The fixed initial context is excluded from both appearance metrics.
